newsitem.title: USA: US House's Archer says Clinton tax plan needs cuts.
newsitem.headline: US House's Archer says Clinton tax plan needs cuts.

text.p: House Ways and Means Committee chairman Bill Archer said he was concerned President Clinton's budget has too high a level of taxes and too much spending.

"The budget offers the American people what may be temporary tax relief, combined with permanent tax hikes, adding up to an excessive tax burden. That aspect of the budget must be improved," the Texas Republican said.

He said he saw little support for restoring $21 billion to welfare spending but he commended Clinton for moving in a "more reasonable direction," on Medicare. He added that he was optimistic "fast track" trade legislation would be passed.
